records.subject: maintenance_procedure
value: If cold, warm engine several minutes at idle.
Stop engine and wait several minutes for oil to settle.
Hold scooter upright on level ground.
Check window, or remove/wipe dipstick and insert fully without screwing in.
Level must be between upper/lower marks; top up to upper mark with same oil if at lower mark.

records.subject: maintenance_procedure
value: Park upright on level ground and read left floor-panel inspection window.

records.subject: maintenance_procedure
value: Check front and rear reservoirs with front reservoir horizontal.
Fluid must be above LOWER line.
If below LOWER, dealer adjusts level; dealer immediately if leakage is found.

records.subject: maintenance_procedure
value: Inspect pads in front and rear calipers.
If any lining reaches minimum-thickness line, dealer replaces pads.
Replace pads as a set; upper/lower front pad wear may differ.

records.subject: maintenance_procedure
value: Confirm grip moves smoothly full-open to closed.

records.subject: maintenance_procedure

records.subject: maintenance_procedure
value: Open front compartment and fuse box.

records.subject: maintenance_procedure
value: Replace if electrodes have heavy deposits or insulator is damaged.
Measure gap with wire-type feeler gauge; if needed carefully bend side electrode.

records.subject: maintenance_procedure
value: Remove air-box cover screws/cover, then element screws and element.
Dealer replaces element if damaged or too dirty.
Reinstall in reverse; drain air-box drain hose if needed; prevent dust entering inlet; use genuine element.

records.subject: maintenance_procedure
value: Dealer replaces V-belt air-cleaner element if damaged or too dirty.
CRUiSYM alpha 125 is not equipped with V-belt air cleaner.

records.subject: maintenance_procedure
records.value: Use screwdriver on vertical adjuster; headlight aiming should be performed by authorized dealer.

records.subject: maintenance_procedure
value: Standard rear-shock preload position is 2 of 4.
Turn adjuster counter-clockwise to increase preload/harden; clockwise to decrease/soften.
Do not exceed adjuster limit; contact authorized dealer.

records.subject: maintenance_procedure
value: Cool engine, muffler, brakes and other hot parts before washing; cover exhaust outlet and ignition-switch slot.
Rinse with cold water; wash with neutral scooter/automotive detergent and sponge; rinse clean.
Blow off/dry with soft cloth; ride slowly and apply brakes repeatedly to dry them.
Do not pressure-rinse radiator; never wax matte plastic.

records.subject: Engine does not start
value: Confirm ignition key is in ON position.
Confirm sufficient fuel / gauge is not at E.
Apply either front or rear brake while pressing starter.
Confirm engine-stop switch is in run position.
With ignition ON, press horn; if it does not sound, the fuse may be blown.
Open front compartment and inspect fuse box; replace an obviously melted fuse wire with specified fuse.

records.subject: Overheating
value: Symptoms: seventh (H) coolant-gauge sector lights or acceleration is sluggish.
Pull safely to roadside; turn ignition OFF to stop engine, then ON.
Check radiator-fan operation, then turn ignition OFF.
If fan does not operate: do not restart; transport to authorized dealer.
If fan operates: cool engine, inspect cooling hose and leakage.
If leak exists: do not restart; transport to authorized dealer.

records.subject: TCS indicator remains on / TCS deactivated
